plan.title: Donation Insights
plan.subtitle: Track monthly trends, top cities, payment modes, and donor frequency

panels.title: Monthly Trend
panels.sql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST("Date" AS DATE)) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) SELECT month, total FROM monthly

panels.title: Top 10 Cities
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Payment Modes
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Repeat Donors
panels.sql: WITH donor_counts AS (SELECT "Donor", COUNT(*) AS freq FROM "donor_transactions" GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) SELECT "Donor", freq FROM donor_counts ORDER BY freq DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative:
This dashboard provides a comprehensive view of donation activities. The top row highlights key metrics including the total number of donations, the aggregate amount raised, the count of unique donors, and the average donation size. These figures offer an immediate snapshot of the campaign's scale and donor engagement.

The line chart visualizes the monthly trend, allowing you to observe how donation volume fluctuates over time. This helps in identifying peak giving periods and seasonal patterns. Below that, the bar charts break down performance by geography and payment method, revealing which cities contribute the most funds and which payment modes are preferred by the donor base.

Finally, the table lists repeat donors, highlighting individuals who have contributed multiple times. Identifying these loyal supporters is crucial for retention strategies and future engagement campaigns.
